request: Create a realistic 15-second UGC try-on review with a mirror reveal.
product_context: Quilted outerwear with fixed sleeve length, zipper track, collar, pocket placement, and panel pattern.
expected_behavior: Use detail inspection, try-on, mirror reveal, and verdict as the main progression.
Keep garment construction and creator wardrobe consistent.
Treat the mirror shot as a high-risk continuity moment.
critical_constraints: Preserve sleeve, zipper, collar, pocket, and quilting geometry.
Avoid depending on readable mirrored packaging or logos.
failure_conditions: Mirror creates duplicate limbs or impossible phone placement.
Garment length or construction changes in the reveal.
The creator changes clothing or identity between adjacent shots.
